name: novelbite
description: A privacy-first, context-aware meal recommendation PWA and reproducible data pipeline.

scripts.predev: npm run config:write && npm run vendor:copy
scripts.prebuild: npm run config:write && npm run vendor:copy
scripts.check: node --check src/app/main.js && node --check src/recommendations/engine.js && node --check src/ledger/store.js && node --check src/schedule/shifts.js && node --check src/storage/local.js && node --check src/storage/cloud.js && node --check src/ui/render.js
scripts.data:refresh: npm run data:workbook && npm run data:build && npm run data:validate
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run data:validate && npm run test:coverage && npm run benchmark && npm run build
